# button, badge, link, image and the components that render generically all
# have declared android bodies now — nothing in compose_ir.go is keyed on any
# of their names. What each assertion below pins is the override body, so a
# body deleted or rewritten in lib/platforms/android/android.sngl fails here.

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=out app.sngl

# button is a Button whose onClick is the @click handler's body and whose
# child is a Text of `text`. The label goes through the declared Text
# intrinsic, so it is a named `text =` argument, not a positional one.
grep 'Button\(onClick = \{$' out/MainScreen.kt
grep 'n \+= 1$' out/MainScreen.kt
grep '\}, modifier = Modifier\.padding\(4\.dp\)\) \{$' out/MainScreen.kt
grep 'Text\(text = "bump", modifier = Modifier\)$' out/MainScreen.kt

# An unwired button still gets a lambda, because Compose's onClick is not
# optional.
grep 'Button\(onClick = \{\}, modifier = Modifier\) \{$' out/MainScreen.kt

# badge wraps its `value` in Badge, and the style reaches Badge's modifier.
grep 'Badge\(modifier = Modifier\.padding\(6\.dp\)\) \{$' out/MainScreen.kt
grep 'Text\(text = "7", modifier = Modifier\)$' out/MainScreen.kt

# link is a Text carrying the theme's primary colour, which Style has no
# field for and the override therefore spells in Kotlin via `args`.
grep 'Text\(text = "Home", modifier = Modifier, color = MaterialTheme\.colorScheme\.primary\)$' out/MainScreen.kt

# android draws no image: the override is an unsized Spacer, and no Image
# composable and no TODO comment is emitted.
grep 'Spacer\(modifier = Modifier\)$' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'TODO: Image' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'Image\(' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'unknown' out/MainScreen.kt

# chip renders its label as bare text — the honest statement of what android
# does with a chip today, and no AssistChip is emitted.
grep 'Text\(text = "Tag", modifier = Modifier\)$' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'AssistChip' out/MainScreen.kt

# toolbar/popover/drawer/tooltip/splitview are a Column over their children.
grep 'Column\(modifier = Modifier\.padding\(9\.dp\)\) \{$' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'DropdownMenu' out/MainScreen.kt

# menubar has no children and no text prop the override could show, so it is
# an empty Text. avatar is the same.
grep 'Text\(text = "", modifier = Modifier\)$' out/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component main {
    var n = 0

    vbox {
        button(style={padding=4}, text="bump", @click { n += 1 })
        button(text="quiet")
        badge(style={padding=6}, value="7")
        link(href="/", text="Home")
        image(src="/logo.png", alt="logo")
        chip(label="Tag")
        toolbar(style={padding=9}) {
            button(text="New")
        }
        menubar(items=["File"])
        avatar(initials="JD")
    }
}
